title: Compact tier experiment: per-token splits, streaming surcharge, and enterprise contract Q updates
creator: Anika Rao
description: Run a pricing experiment for the Hosted API that evaluates compact per-token bands with asymmetric input/output rates, an explicit streaming connection surcharge, and a minimum monthly billing floor for low-volume enterprise customers. This ticket coordinates pricing hypothesis, telemetry, legal contract language updates (SOW/minimums), and changes to the enterprise security questionnaire to ensure we can surface streaming data retention and encryption commitments.
objective: Determine whether a compact tier (fewer price points) with explicit input/output differentiation, a small per-connection streaming surcharge, and a conservative enterprise minimum improves revenue predictability without harming PLG conversion and usage growth.
hypothesis: If we introduce 3 compact price bands (starter/standard/premium) with 1) input tokens priced at 40-60% of output tokens, 2) a $0.002 per-minute streaming connection surcharge for long-lived streams, and 3) a $100/mo enterprise minimum for contract customers, then net revenue per active account will increase by >=12% while conversion rate from trial to paid remains +/-3% of baseline.
success_metrics: Net revenue per active account: +12% vs baseline
Trial->paid conversion delta: within +/-3% of baseline
Average request latency and error-rate unchanged: p95 latency change <5%, error rate delta <0.2%
Churn signal for existing enterprise customers: no material increase (monthly churn delta <1%)
experiment_design: Cohort A (control): current per-token pricing and existing streaming behavior
Cohort B (compact): new 3-band pricing, input/output split, streaming surcharge, enterprise min applied only to new contract signings during experiment
Randomize at account-level for self-serve signups; sales-assisted enterprise deals will be offered a parallel optional appendix in contracts handled by Sales/Legal
12 week experiment window with interim 4-week checkins
Telemetry: instrument billed_token_input, billed_token_output, streaming_connection_minutes, account_minimum_flag, conversion_event, churn_event
pricing_proposals_sample: Starter: $0.0035/output-token, input-token = 0.0016 (45% of output), soft rate limit 40 rps, ideal for small apps
Standard: $0.0022/output-token, input-token = 0.0009 (40% of output), includes 10k free streaming minutes/month, then $0.0018/minute surcharge
Premium: $0.0011/output-token, input-token = 0.0005 (45% of output), committed throughput discount; enterprise minimum applies to contract sales: $100/mo
Streaming model variant: $0.002 per active connection hour (billed per minute) with per-request token billing still applied
acceptance_criteria: Pricing bands implemented in billing system and feature-flagged
Telemetry events emitted and dashboards built (revenue, token volumes split by input/output, streaming minutes)
Legal and Sales-approved contract appendix drafted that describes minimums and streaming surcharges
Security questionnaire updated to include streaming retention, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, and KV cache handling disclosures
A/B assignment logic validated in staging and smoke-tested for billing accuracy
